$comment: Variables the build bakes into client code. A new public variable is a deliberate line here, not just a NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix on a name. build — NEXT_PUBLIC_* only; serverBuild — non-secret names without the prefix that the build needs (not baked into the client). The deploy passes only these names to docker build; the check-public-env gate compares the lists with the code and .env.example.
